annotations.title: Search open calls and recent awards

description: Keyword search over the public consulting calls open now and the consulting awards of the last six months in Europe (title, buyer and winners; words match the start of words, accents ignored). Search in English: every title is also indexed in an English translation; add words in the country's language only as extra variants. To explore a topic, put the variants (synonyms, the country's languages) in one call with queries[] instead of calling several times. Filter by status, country, kind of work, minimum value or winning firm. Each result has the public link to its notice, title (the notice's own) and title_en (machine translation), and a link to the same view in the radar; an open call also has its page on arquestra.dev (page: summary, bid checklist, weekly alert). Paged: up to 25 a page, 100 a query (100 merged rows for queries[]); each search run counts as one call against the daily caps. The result also carries search_by_meaning, the radar's search by meaning for the same words.

country.description: A country (ISO code or name), or several separated by commas: ESP,FRA.

expand.description: Also run the same words from a small built-in list of common consulting topic words (environment, audit, evaluation, training, mobility, health, energy, water, digital, legal, communication, procurement...): English synonyms over every title, and the country's languages (en, fr, nl, de, es, it) over the rows with no English title. Marked expanded in by_query; up to 16 searches in all. Default false.

firm.description: Only awards won by a firm whose name contains this.

kind.description: A kind of work, or a subtype: procurement_advisory (advising public buyers on their tenders), statutory_audit (audit of accounts), data_protection (data protection officer), hse_advisory (workplace health and safety advice).

lang.description: Language of the page links (the data is the same). Default en.

queries.description: Up to 8 searches in one call (synonyms, other languages' words, other countries, other firms: e.g. the awards of two firms and the open calls on a topic in one call): run together, rows merged without repeats, each row's matched lists the searches that found it (rows found by more come first), by_query gives each search's count, one panel. An item's filters replace the call's own; unset, the call's apply.

firm.description: Only awards won by a firm whose name contains this (one item per firm).

query.description: Words to find; may be empty when firm is given (all that firm's awards).

Words to find (at least one word of 3 letters, or none with firm: all that firm's recent awards). All words must match; if none does, the rows matching most words are returned and marked. Give query or queries.

via.description: Leave this out. Set only by the radar's panel (MCP App) when the person uses its filters or 'show more' (panel), or by the site owner's own tests (dev), so that use is counted apart.
